verdict.rationale: AFK auto-decomposes goals into task graphs and integrates with tools like Mercury, Gusto, Carta, and Stripe, showing some AI-driven workflow/tool-use behavior, but there is no evidence users can explicitly author or insert AI/LLM steps, or choose a model within a workflow — the AI orchestration appears fixed and automatic rather than a configurable authoring surface. Missing for 10: user-facing model selection, explicit ability to add/configure an AI agent step, documentation of tool-use configuration per step.
